messages:
sam: Quick shout 0th: rooftop LAN this Sat? Thinking mix of Switch, a couple consoles, and PC co-op. Casual.

riley: In if theres Mario Kart. I can bring my Switch + dock.

jas: Ill bring a GTX laptop and a 24" monitor. Also two Cat6s.

sam: Nice. Anyone have a spare capture card for Switch clips? Could do a quick highlights reel.

riley: I have an old Elgato HD60. Happy to bring.

jas: Food plan? I can grab 2 large pizzas. Vegan ok?

sam: Vegan + one gluten-free slice would be ace.

ops-bot: Reminder: rooftop events need ops notice. Filing form now.

riley: Heads-up: if we run AoE2 or older LANs, may need to open port 2300 on Linux boxes (ufw).

jas: Got it. Ill run a quick check prior. Also bringing a multi-outlet surge and HDMI switch.

sam: Plan: setup 4:30pm, games from 5pm. Please label your gear and bring small extension cords. Street parking only.

riley: Reaction poll: react with emoji for priority first game 0: :kart: Mario Kart, :smash: Smash, :retro: Retro hour, :party: Party games

sam: :kart:

jas: :retro:

riley: :smash:

ops-bot: Poll live 13 Mario Kart 1, Smash 1, Retro 1

sam: Cool. See you Saturday. Bring controllers you dont want to lose. Label them :)
